description.value: Fire Pizza is a pizza-focused fast-food spot on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, a lively, cyclist-frequented corridor in East Vancouver. It offers both takeout and delivery, making it a convenient stop for riders passing through the neighbourhood. The location on Commercial Drive puts it within easy reach of cycling routes connecting East Vancouver to the broader city grid.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms the address (1918 Commercial Drive Vancouver, BC V5N 4A6) and provides a phone number (604-253-5607) absent from OSM tags. The website explicitly lists 'Takeout' and 'Delivery' as order modes, making Takeout value=true. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; phone 604-253-5607 sourced from website only.
Several website subpages (/about, /contact, /sitep.jsp) returned 404 Not Found, limiting ability to verify full menu or amenity details.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant on Commercial Drive with a functioning website and confirmed address; suitable for the directory as a food stop on a well-travelled cycling corridor.
